_readme: Demo storefront artwork used by DemoStoreSeeder.
These files are NOT fetched during seeding. Run `php artisan demo:fetch-images`
once to download them into this directory; the seeder then copies whatever is
present and falls back to generated artwork when a file is missing, so seeding
works offline and in CI either way.
Source: Unsplash (https://unsplash.com). The Unsplash License permits free use,
including commercially, without attribution; it does not permit redistributing
the photos to build a competing image service. Attribution is recorded below
anyway so the provenance of every committed binary is traceable.
Every photo_id below was downloaded and visually checked. Unsplash IDs are
opaque and get reused, so an id that merely looks plausible is not enough:
the ids originally copied from templates/storeprofile.html returned a
watermelon and a glass of beer.
